config.route:
- route:
    from:
      uri: direct:partner-merchant-soap
      steps:
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'INQUIRY'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=INQUIRY.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-soap-call?address=http://mw-simulators:8080/merchant-soap/v1/soap&request=soap.request.xsl&response=soap.response.xsl&soapAction=urn:merchant:v1:ValidateMerchant&wsUsername=bits&wsPasswordSecret=ws-password"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=INQUIRY.response&definiteStatuses=200"
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'PAY'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=PAY.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-soap-call?address=http://mw-simulators:8080/merchant-soap/v1/soap&request=soap.request.xsl&response=soap.response.xsl&soapAction=urn:merchant:v1:NotifyPayment&wsUsername=bits&wsPasswordSecret=ws-password"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=PAY.response&definiteStatuses=200"
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'REVERSE'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=REVERSE.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-soap-call?address=http://mw-simulators:8080/merchant-soap/v1/soap&request=soap.request.xsl&response=soap.response.xsl&soapAction=urn:merchant:v1:Refund&wsUsername=bits&wsPasswordSecret=ws-password"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=REVERSE.response&definiteStatuses=200"
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'STATUS_QUERY'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=STATUS_QUERY.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-soap-call?address=http://mw-simulators:8080/merchant-soap/v1/soap&request=soap.request.xsl&response=soap.response.xsl&soapAction=urn:merchant:v1:QueryNotify&wsUsername=bits&wsPasswordSecret=ws-password"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=STATUS_QUERY.response&definiteStatuses=200"
        - to: "kamelet:mw-audit"

mappings.soap.request.xsl:
<xsl:stylesheet version="3.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform"
    xmlns:fn="http://www.w3.org/2005/xpath-functions" xmlns:m="urn:merchant:v1" exclude-result-prefixes="fn">
  <xsl:template match="/fn:map[fn:string[@key='op'] = 'NOTIFY']">
    <m:NotifyPayment>
      <m:merchantId><xsl:value-of select="fn:*[@key='merchantId']"/></m:merchantId>
      <m:tillId><xsl:value-of select="fn:*[@key='tillId']"/></m:tillId>
      <m:amount><xsl:value-of select="fn:*[@key='amount']"/></m:amount>
      <m:reference><xsl:value-of select="fn:*[@key='reference']"/></m:reference>
    </m:NotifyPayment>
  </xsl:template>
  <xsl:template match="/fn:map[fn:string[@key='op'] = 'REFUND']">
    <m:Refund>
      <m:merchantId><xsl:value-of select="fn:*[@key='merchantId']"/></m:merchantId>
      <m:amount><xsl:value-of select="fn:*[@key='amount']"/></m:amount>
      <m:reference><xsl:value-of select="fn:*[@key='reference']"/></m:reference>
      <m:refundId><xsl:value-of select="fn:*[@key='refundId']"/></m:refundId>
    </m:Refund>
  </xsl:template>
  <xsl:template match="/fn:map[fn:string[@key='op'] = 'QUERY']">
    <m:QueryNotify>
      <m:merchantId><xsl:value-of select="fn:*[@key='merchantId']"/></m:merchantId>
      <m:reference><xsl:value-of select="fn:*[@key='reference']"/></m:reference>
    </m:QueryNotify>
  </xsl:template>
  <xsl:template match="/fn:map" priority="-1">
    <m:ValidateMerchant>
      <m:merchantId><xsl:value-of select="fn:*[@key='merchantId']"/></m:merchantId>
      <m:tillId><xsl:value-of select="fn:*[@key='tillId']"/></m:tillId>
    </m:ValidateMerchant>
  </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>
mappings.soap.response.xsl:
<xsl:stylesheet version="3.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform"
    xmlns:m="urn:merchant:v1" xmlns:f="urn:bits:mw:soap-fault">
  <xsl:output method="json"/>
  <xsl:template match="/m:ValidateMerchantResponse">
    <xsl:sequence select="map{'reply': 'VALIDATE', 'status': string(m:status), 'merchantRef': string(m:merchantRef)}"/>
  </xsl:template>
  <xsl:template match="/m:NotifyPaymentResponse">
    <xsl:sequence select="map{'reply': 'NOTIFY', 'status': string(m:status), 'notifyRef': string(m:notifyRef),
        'code': string(m:code)}"/>
  </xsl:template>
  <xsl:template match="/m:RefundResponse">
    <xsl:sequence select="map{'reply': 'REFUND', 'status': string(m:status), 'refundRef': string(m:refundRef),
        'code': string(m:code)}"/>
  </xsl:template>
  <xsl:template match="/m:QueryNotifyResponse">
    <xsl:sequence select="map{'reply': 'QUERY', 'status': string(m:status), 'notifyRef': string(m:notifyRef)}"/>
  </xsl:template>
  <xsl:template match="/f:fault">
    <xsl:sequence select="map{'fault': string(@code), 'code': string(f:detail/m:error/m:code),
        'message': string(f:detail/m:error/m:message)}"/>
  </xsl:template>
  <xsl:template match="/*" priority="-1">
    <xsl:sequence select="map{'reply': 'OTHER'}"/>
  </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>
